messages:
olivia: heads-up — nebula-9b-int4 bringup shows a 7% drop on our cross-domain golden prompts vs float16 (qbench run nebula-177531). Could be recent curation merges, token changes, or the new low-precision kernel.

marc: which goldset and run details? can you paste the quick stats?

olivia: goldsets/nebula/gold_2026_04/nebula_gold_v1.jsonl. run id nebula-177531, seed=20260401. sample 3.5k. metrics: 
```
metric: exact_match 0.878 -> 0.815
accept_rate 0.92 -> 0.87
regression_count 224/3500 (top labels: missing-args, truncation, token-split)
```

priya: recent curation note: we merged region-anchors and applied a faster dedupe sweep with thresh=0.9 to speed throughput last week. also added the paraphrase-merge stage.

zane: infra note: the int4 runtime moved to kernel-lowp-v5 two nights ago and enabled tokenizer-v4 as default in the runtime. kv-cache shortprefix behavior also changed in that rollout. all three could affect outputs.

marc: triage proposal: 1) reproduce float16 on the exact same tokenized inputs (tokenizer v4) 2) rerun dedupe at 0.94 and 0.98 to measure overlap 3) generate failure export (top-250) with both float16 and int4 outputs side-by-side 4) kernel bisect across kernel-lowp-v4->v5 and tokenizer v3->v4. owners: olivia=datasets, marc=tokdiff+overlap, priya=label ops, zane=kernel/infra.

olivia: starting step 1 now. will regen tokenized inputs with tokenizer v4 and run float16 locally.

marc: commands if helpful: 
```
python -m curation.dedupe --input nebula_gold_v1.jsonl --thresh 0.94 --out nebula_gold_v1.dedupe094.jsonl
python -m curation.tokenize --input nebula_gold_v1.dedupe094.jsonl --tokenizer v4 --out nebula_tok_v4.jsonl
python -m qbench.run --model nebula-9b-fp16 --input nebula_tok_v4.jsonl --seed 20260401 --out qbench-nebula-fp16.jsonl
```

priya: labeling capacity: contractors + internal can do up to 300 if we tag as "nebula-int4-triage" and expedite. i'll stand up the batch once you upload the top-250 fail export. include context +/-2 turns and both model outputs.

infra-bot: [qbench-ci] pipeline nebula-177531 triggered for model=nebula-9b-int4 input=nebula_tok_v4.jsonl. Status: running.

zane: also compute token-diff stats between tokenizer v3 and v4 — small subtoken shifts can be amplified by quant noise. script: 
```
python -m curation.tokdiff --a nebula_tok_v3.jsonl --b nebula_tok_v4.jsonl --out tokdiff_nebula.json
```

marc: ran initial tokdiff on a 1k sample: ~3.1% of prompts have >1 token change; of those, many are math/code examples and bullet lists. these are high-impact for exact-match metrics.

olivia: float16 repro on nebula_tok_v4.jsonl matches baseline (0.878 -> 0.876) so data/tokenization alone doesn't fully explain. int4 run still shows drop. infra-bot please attach run artifacts when complete.

infra-bot: [qbench-ci] nebula-177531 completed: regression detected. Dashboard: https://ci.internal/qbench/nebula-177531/overview. Artifacts: s3://redwood-curation/exports/nebula-177531-fails.jsonl

marc: next: compare failure sets between dedupe=0.94 vs 0.98 to estimate curation noise. i'll run overlap and produce top-250 prioritized set with failure-kind tags.

priya: once top-250 uploaded, i'll create label batch LB-5099 tag=nebula-int4-triage and assign contractors. we should instruct labelers to annotate whether the failure is due to tokenization/paraphrase ambiguity vs model hallucination. include a quick acceptance rubric.

zane: kernel bisect plan: reproduce int4 on kernel-lowp-v4 (old) and kernel-lowp-v5 (current) with same tokenized inputs. if regression disappears on v4, we isolate kernel change. if persists across kernels, suspect quant path + kv-cache. I'll coordinate revert PR if needed.

marc: small note on kv-cache: shortprefix truncation can change generation alignment; add a quick check by toggling KV_SHORTPREFIX=false in runtime and rerunning a 500-sample qbench to see delta.

olivia: uploaded failures: s3://redwood-curation/exports/nebula-177531-fails-top250.jsonl (contains float16/int4 outputs, fail_kind, tokdiff counts). opening label batch now.

priya: label batch LB-5099 created with 250 items, tag=nebula-int4-triage, owners=contractors+priya. estimated completion: EOD.

zane: kernel bisect initial result: kernel-lowp-v4 reproduces baseline (exact_match ~0.875), kernel-lowp-v5 reproduces regression (~0.815). looks like kernel-lowp-v5 introduced a change. compiling minimal repro to open infra ticket.

marc: good find. let's get a small failing-case diff and file for kernel team. also check whether tokenizer v4 interactions amplify the kernel delta. run matrix: {kernel v4/v5} x {tokenizer v3/v4}.

olivia: scheduled a 30m sync with kernel + curation to decide rollback vs patch. owners for action items: zane=open infra ticket + revert PR candidate, marc=matrix runs + failure delta, priya=track label results, olivia=postmortem.

priya: will post label audit summary once LB-5099 closes. if >60% of fails labeled as paraphrase/dup noise we may prefer curation patch; otherwise revert kernel.

olivia: thanks team, keeping this thread as source-of-truth. will update after the sync. :thumbsup:
